summary: Fresh independent full-file R2 review of the pure module, all 379 test lines, integration policy, and full style policy. The direct regression at tests/test_translation_v2_editorial.py:326-336 and an independent simultaneous-two-page/record-and-text-alias smoke pass. R1 page-identity suggestion is explicitly addressed at docs/translation-editorial-integration-v2.md:24; caller page/registry/current-page equality remains a required precondition, not a property proved by the helper. Exact raw-source and CRLF-only normalized whole-English binding, immutable Arabic prefix, historical provenance attribution, literal supplied Arabic examples, and narrow EN-style-only exceptions are consistent; ID, folio, missing-text and structural diagnostics remain blocking. Parallel workers must defer live reader rebuilds; the coordinator owns the frozen candidate. Independently reran the focused editorial suite: 164 passed, using cached pytest 9.1.1 without installation, bytecode, cacheprovider or plugin autoload. The supplied fixer log separately records 332 tests and 49 subtests passed; this review does not claim an independent full-suite rerun. The requested diffdocs/translation-style-v2.md does not exist; reviewed docs/translation-style-v2.md, the actual fourth path bound in R1. The normal interpreter lacked pytest and the previous isolated test interpreter had expired; cached package imports provided a working read-only test alternative. Final raw SHA-256 values match the initial review snapshot. No repository source, page-95 targets, canonical corpus, correction files, state, Git index or commits were modified; only this new review JSON was written.
